scope: Executed pilot logs and raw measurements. Only selected-source-v3 and selected-v3 are the accepted final selection. Hardware is the existing B300 MIG, and every GPU process ran serially.
architecture_control: An initial sm_100a retarget of B300 hardware-reduction forward was rejected for tcgen05.ld.red. Final SM100 checks use the actual software-reduction forward path; the rejection is retained as a negative control.
invalid_control: chunk128-v1 changed the backward operand policy on both baseline and candidate through the host wrapper; exclude its comparison from performance claims.

selection_history.selected-source/selected: First selection widened forward boxes for both D256 and D512; stopped with exit 143 after the matrix exposed a D256 forward regression. Files and partial measurements are retained.
selection_history.selected-source-v2/selected-v2: Validated intermediate widens D512 only; SASS then revealed stack growth from 64 to 624 bytes. Replaced by v3 after a paired pilot showed 64-column correction windows improved latency.
selection_history.selected-source-v3/selected-v3: Final selection keeps 128-wide D512 matrix boxes with 64-column correction/register windows.
